title: Choose the visual world for the ICSIFT home page
question: The roll assigned the Certificate & CPD Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Certificate & CPD Ledger
options.lineage: security-printed certificates, banknotes and credit ledgers
options.thesis: The home page is the credential itself: one security-printed sheet with two tear-off counterfoils, Submit Paper and Register.
options.viewport: A security-printed certificate fills the screen: the conference name engraved, 21–22 set as a banknote denomination, a guilloche rosette seal, a ledger of the credit a participant earns (Scopus/Clarivate publication, CPD hours, 15+ awards, hybrid participation), and two equal perforated counterfoils along the bottom that are the working Submit Paper and Register actions.
options.risk: Set timidly it slides into cream-and-serif diploma kitsch or reads bureaucratic; it has to be engraved, saturated and exact.

raised.raise: There's no card grid. Content sits on the document's own ruled ledger lines and bands, never in floating boxes.
Everything is measured against one engraved grid: guilloche bands, ledger rules and type all snap to a single baseline unit.
Every region is captioned with exactly what it is, the way a document's fields are (Date of issue, Venue, Credit), so no decorative headings are needed.
Loudness scales with consequence: the two counterfoils and the dates are set loudest; everything else steps down.

options.label: The Indexed Article
options.lineage: the first page of a Scopus-indexed journal article
options.thesis: The home page is set as the first page of the paper you are about to publish.
options.viewport: A running head names the proceedings; the conference title is set as the article title; Received/Accepted/Indexed metadata in the margin carries the important dates and credit; the abstract is the About text, keywords are the focus areas, and Submit Paper and Register sit as two equal actions under the abstract.
options.risk: It's the closest to where most runs in this category land: editorial hairlines and a serif display. Familiar, and quieter on the industry audience.

options.label: Starship Crew Terminal
options.thesis: The conference is a ship's terminal you query in green capitals.
options.viewport: A typed query line prints conference facts one line at a time.
options.risk: It costumes a sustainability conference as sci-fi; academics don't recognise themselves in it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it loses audience identification and hides the offer behind typing.
options.kept: Labelling discipline: every zone names exactly what it is.

options.label: Futurist Bolted Book
options.thesis: Every section is a typographic collision read at engine speed.
options.viewport: Angled wood-type shouts of the dates and theme.
options.risk: Angled type fights the dense facts scholars need to read.
options.case: Fuses poorly: clarity collapses under angled type.
options.kept: Scale by consequence: the loudest type goes to what matters most.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.thesis: Past editions as a scratched film strip.
options.viewport: A strip of frames from earlier editions running across the top.
options.risk: It turns the event's proof into an art filter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strong for the gallery, weak for submit-and-register.
options.kept: Strict banded rhythm: one full-width band per section.

options.label: Miura-Fold Sheet
options.thesis: The programme unfolds from a packet into a full sheet.
options.viewport: A compact packet that unfolds into the conference details.
options.risk: The mechanism is novel but unrelated to what attendees do.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no tie to the audience's world.
options.kept: Compact-to-deployed: details unfold from a summary.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap lines drifting over a black void.
options.viewport: A single ivory line of the conference name over drifting dust.
options.risk: It reads as a games-scene in-joke to an academic audience.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it loses both axes.
options.kept: Never enclose: structure without boxes or cards.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: Conference signals traced on a graticule.
options.viewport: A waveform sweeps across a ten-division grid with the dates as readouts.
options.risk: It's an instrument costume, not the audience's daily world.
options.case: Fuses poorly: only engineers identify with it, and clarity drops.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The academic-conference site everyone ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A green-tinted photo hero with the title, dates and two pill buttons, then a row of four feature cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other conference site, and close to what ICSIFT has now.
